build_flash_mistral_model: build a FlashMistral model from a model path to generate text embeddings for a batch of inputs
create_mistral_decoder_layer: create a MistralDecoderLayer with attention and MLP sublayers for a given layer index and config
load_weight_from_safetensors: load a weight tensor from a safetensors file by name using a weight map and target device
compute_rope_parameters: compute default rotary position embedding parameters from a MistralConfig including inverse frequencies and attention scaling
embed_batch: embed a FlashBatch or PaddedBatch of input IDs into fixed-size embedding vectors using the FlashMistral model
